turei-zahav/1:_.en: It is written in the Tur — source. of the Hashem of Israel, but it is not in the heart of the day, but the things that are permitted in it, and in the midst of Hashem’s command, and the removal of the tefillin, if he wants to wait until the evening, and if he wants to remove the customs, but I will not be able to do so immediately. "And thou shalt be thrust down and say unto us," In the first days, Hashem’s Word is not allowed to lay down on a second, and if it is in a new face, it is not possible to lay down, and it is not possible to lay down, and if it is a new face, and it is written, if it were to wait for him to see him He said, “What is it that we should do with Hashem’s Word, and that it is not the same as Hashem’s people, and that it is the same as Hashem’s people, and that it is Hashem’s name, and that Hashem’s people will be saved.” It is not the case of Hashem’s Word, nor is it the same as Hashem’s Word, nor is it Hashem’s promise of the Hashem’s Word, and that He will not be able to do so in His Word, and that He will not be able to do so in His Word, and that He will not be able to do so in His Word All day, and all day, Hashem’s glory is not all day, but in the words of the Holy One, it is forbidden to do so, but in the words of the Hashem’s Prayer, it is forbidden to do so, and it is not possible for him to do so in the day of the Hashem’s Prayer This is the case of Hashem’s promise that Hashem’s promise is to be made to Hashem’s people, and that Hashem’s promise is not to be done to Hashem’s people, and that Hashem’s people are not allowed to do so, and that Hashem’s people are not allowed to do so It is not true in the words of our Hashem: the things that we have mentioned above mean that it is permitted in the day of another day that the people of Israel are blessed with him, and that he may not be saved from him, and that he may not be consumed by all the days of the Hashem, and that he may not be used in the night
